sources.note: No statement about stress anywhere. But the wordlist (all three columns, incl. the southern column b) and the southern Lord's Prayer are printed with acute accent marks on one vowel per word, e.g. southern 'Ку́тхай' god, 'Ка́на' devil, 'Ко́халъ' sky, 'Чкуа́да' legs, 'Пайма́нъ' stockings, 'Танга́къ' fur coat, 'Та́ша' fort, 'Куа́шуа' axe, 'Кусга́лъ' day, 'Ку́лкуа' night (pp. 138, 141, viewed on page images).
